mfa.title: Verification code (MFA)
mfa.description: Enter the verification code Medicover sent you (SMS or email).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired — please sign in again.

reauth_mfa.title: Verification code (MFA) — re-authentication
reauth_mfa.description: Enter the verification code Medicover sent you (SMS or email).

data_description.notification_path: Optional HA dashboard path, e.g. /dashboard-health/medicover. Leave empty to use the app default.

error.invalid_notification_path: Enter a relative HA path starting with a single /, without spaces or backslashes.

data_description.notify_target: Choose notify.mobile_app_… for individual appointment notifications with booking actions. Other targets receive a plain list.

abort.cannot_load_filters: Cannot load region list — refresh account data first

error.invalid_search: Check the selected filters and date range.

list_booking_offers.name: Show bookable appointments
list_booking_offers.description: Lists searches and available appointments for all accounts. Optionally select one search.

refresh.name: Refresh search results
refresh.description: Fetches fresh results when listing all searches.

book_appointment.name: Book appointment
book_appointment.description: Books the selected appointment and returns the outcome. Requires a current booking_id.

booking_id.name: Booking identifier
booking_id.description: booking_id from Show bookable appointments or the sensor's appointments attribute.

list_booked_appointments.name: List booked appointments
list_booked_appointments.description: Lists planned appointments for all accounts. Optionally select a search to limit results to its account.

entity_id.name: Medicover account search
entity_id.description: Optional: select a search to list only its account appointments.

cancel_appointment.name: Cancel appointment
cancel_appointment.description: Cancels the selected appointment. Requires a cancellation_id valid for 30 minutes or until HA restarts.

confirm_late_cancellation.name: Confirm late cancellation
confirm_late_cancellation.description: Enable after reviewing Medicover late cancellation terms.

get_search_filters.name: Get search filters
get_search_filters.description: Without parameters returns loaded accounts. Supply an account, then a region and specialty to retrieve dependent filters.

specialty_id.name: Specialty
specialty_id.description: Specialty ID available in the selected region.

create_search.name: Create search
create_search.description: Creates a search editable in HA configuration. Identical retries return the existing search.

specialty_id.name: Specialty
specialty_id.description: Specialty ID available in the selected region.

clinic_id.name: Clinic
clinic_id.description: Optional clinic ID from the filters.

doctor_id.name: Doctor
doctor_id.description: Optional doctor ID from the filters.

notify_target.name: Notification targets
notify_target.description: List of notify targets, as in the search configuration form.

delete_search.name: Delete search
delete_search.description: Deletes a saved search and its notification state. Booked appointments are unchanged. Requires an administrator.

account_id.name: Account
account_id.description: Account ID returned by get_search_filters or list_booking_offers.

search_id.name: Search
search_id.description: Search ID returned by list_booking_offers or create_search.
